agent_explanation: Raw velocity-error force scales as m*kp*(v_desired-v); with m~19.76, kp~25.84 and speed~19.8 vs vcmd~11.8 the raw demand is thousands of N, so the controller must clamp to fmax=160.365. Steps 1-4 show force pinned exactly at 160.365 (clamp active), but at step 5 force jumps to 425.696, exceeding the limit. Likely cause is an inconsistent/missing clamp on the step-5 control path (e.g. conditional bypass, substep scaling, or unclamped branch), not a physics blow-up: positions/velocities evolve smoothly while only the commanded force breaks the bound.
